meta.law: box-specific footprint facts, measured once per bench window with the command in `how` recorded verbatim; the live half of the size report (release archives, HF model trees, local wasm) refreshes in data/sizes.json on every publish_sizes run. A recorded row is a MEASUREMENT, never an estimate. A `files` array on a record restates that record's own per-file lstat values in structured form (same measurement, no new numbers); `publish_sizes.py` recorded_files turns it into the row's model_stack and asserts the sum against the record total.
